verdict.rationale: Qdrant has no native natural-language interface. It can be driven through natural language indirectly: an official MCP server lets AI agents operate it, and agent skills bring Qdrant operations into AI coding assistants. An llms.txt file also supports LLM-mediated use. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface in the product itself, documentation of which operations are reachable via natural language, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the MCP or skills workflows.
